name: Jacqueline Cavalcanti
summary: A Brazilian bantamweight from Syndicate MMA (10-2, age 29), 6-1 in the UFC. She lost a decision to Ketlen Vieira in May. This fight was moved from UFC Qatar to UFC 335.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, busy boxer; three knockouts (two in R1).
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped: both losses on the cards.

keys_to_beat: Take her down and hold her

news.text: Her fight with Michelle Montague moved from UFC Qatar to UFC 335.

sources.title: UFC Pushes Major Qatar Fight Back Several Weeks to UFC 335 in Las Vegas
Undefeated Michelle Montague to face Jacqueline Cavalcanti at UFC Qatar
